messages:
sara: Heads up — planning a staggered Terraform cutover for network+iam this Thursday during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Targeting canary -> remaining AZs.
sam: ack. which modules and workspaces?
ryan: list from prod.tfstate: vpc-module@v2.3.1, transit-gw@v1.8.0, iam-roles@v4.0.0. Are we pinning any versions?
sara: pinning vpc-module to v2.3.1 (verified), transit-gw we’ll canary to v1.8.1 (hotfix), iam-roles keep current but will avoid role renames. will run plan on canary workspace first.
maya: +1. plan output might modify route tables and peering — request explicit review if route replacements show up.
sara: agreed. plan step will post diffs to thread. Deploy-bot will run canary apply if tests pass.
deploy-bot: @sara scheduled canary apply at 02:15 UTC. preflight checks: tffmt, terraform validate, drift detection.
ryan: preflight CI shows drift in edge-subnet tags, will fix before apply. patch created: git/infra#462
sam: rollback strategy? if transit-gw apply fails mid-way, what's escape hatch?
sara: escape hatch: immediate prefix reroute to legacy TGW (route table rp-legacy) + revoke new peering via console script. also we have module version rollback: set transit-gw to v1.8.0 and reapply.
maya: add a runbook snippet to thread, please. quick commands for ops:

```bash
# revert peer attachment
aws ec2 delete-transit-gateway-vpc-attachment --transit-gateway-attachment-id tgw-attach-abc
# reapply pinned module
terraform workspace select prod-us-west-2
terraform apply -var-file=prod.tfvars -target=module.transit-gw
```

sara: good. also KMS key rotation blocked during apply window — @sam pls confirm no auto-rotation scheduled.
sam: confirmed, rotated keys paused. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary plan posted: https://deploy/reports/1729999999/plan
sara: plan shows route changes for az-a only and an IAM role add (non-breaking). running canary apply at 02:20.
ryan: monitoring hooks: Netwatch+CloudTrail alerting, and a smoke test hitting internal API through new path.
maya: if smoke test fails, set deploy-bot to rollback mode by posting `rollback: transit-gw` in thread.
sara: will monitor. tagging oncall @sam and infra-monitoring @pagerduty for the window.
sam: I'll be oncall. if rollback needed, I'll coordinate the pinned-version apply and route revert.
ryan: after canary, we do a 10m observation, then stagger remaining AZs in 15m increments.
sara: plan looks good. last ask: release notes snippet for product: short note about new TGW routes and no customer-impact expected.
maya: noted, will draft.
sara: thanks everyone. I'll update this thread with canary outputs.
deploy-bot: canary apply started at 02:20 UTC, job id apply-8832, status: running.
sara: (later) canary apply succeeded, smoke tests green. proceeding with staggered apply.
sam: oncall standing by. :eyes:
ryan: reminder to keep tfstate locks held until final rollback window closes (+30m).
sara: final: cutover complete at 03:42 UTC, no regressions observed. closing thread. :tada:
